The main structure is mine; the article was organized with assistance from Codex.

/posts/2025/10/29/waveform-source-channe.zhExcerpt: 本章是信息论中从离散到连续的过渡，核心在于“连续信源与信道的信息度量”。主要介绍波形信源的统计特性、连续信源的熵定义与性质、最大差熵定理，以及连续与波形信道的信息传输率和信道容量。
/posts/2025/10/29/waveform-source-channe.enExcerpt: This chapter marks the transition from discrete to continuous models in information theory. Its central concern is the measurement of information in continuous sources and channels, including the statistical properties of waveform sources, differential entropy and its properties, the maximum differential-entropy theorem, information rates, and channel capacity.

/posts/2025/10/29/discrete-channel-capac.zhTitle: 第三章 离散信道及其信道容量
/posts/2025/10/29/discrete-channel-capac.enTitle: Information Theory, Chapter 3: Discrete Channels and Channel Capacity
/posts/2025/10/29/discrete-channel-capac.zhExcerpt: 如何在有干扰的条件下，最大效率、最可靠的传输信息？这里来讲一下离散信道的数学模型、平均互信息量、信道容量
/posts/2025/10/29/discrete-channel-capac.enExcerpt: How can information be transmitted as efficiently and reliably as possible in the presence of interference? This chapter introduces the mathematical model of a discrete channel, average mutual information, and channel capacity.

/posts/2025/10/23/discrete-source-entrop.zhTitle: 第二章 离散信源及其信息测度
/posts/2025/10/23/discrete-source-entrop.enTitle: Information Theory, Chapter 2: Discrete Sources and Measures of Information
/posts/2025/10/23/discrete-source-entrop.zhExcerpt: 讲了一下信息量的衡量方式、信源的量化模型和典型模型
/posts/2025/10/23/discrete-source-entrop.enExcerpt: This chapter introduces measures of information, mathematical descriptions of sources, and several representative source models.

/posts/2025/10/22/spectral-analysis/.zhTitle: 第三章 随机过程-谱分析
/posts/2025/10/22/spectral-analysis/.zhExcerpt: 本章研究随机信号在频域中的统计特性，重点讨论功率谱密度的定义、性质、与自相关函数的关系、互谱密度以及白噪声特性。
/posts/2025/10/22/spectral-analysis/.enExcerpt: This chapter examines the statistical characteristics of random signals in the frequency domain, focusing on the definition and properties of power spectral density, its relationship with the autocorrelation function, cross-spectral density, and the characteristics of white noise.

/posts/2025/10/21/time-domain-analysis/.enExcerpt: Time-varying random phenomena, such as noise and interference, can be described by a random process—a family of time functions—and characterised through statistical averages, including means, correlation functions, and probability distributions, rather than through a deterministic function.
